monument_name: Digichẽ  at Ī Bahī (rebuilt in ca. 1936 CE)
anglicized_name: God house at the Ashoka Stupa North
description_en: The two-storeyed Digichẽ at Ī Bahī is actually an Āgaṃchẽ of the Aśoka Stūpa North. Esoteric deities are kept on the first floor. The single-bay Digichẽ features some beautifully executed decorative plaster work which unfortunately has become damaged in many places. Rebuilt after the Great Earthquake of 1934, the god house's structure still incorporates older building elements such as the first-floor windows on the main façade. A lack of regular maintenance as well as damage caused by the 2015 earthquake have left the building exposed to the elements. Parts of the roof structure have collapsed and the walls that have been laid in mud mortar show signs of delamination. A new stone pavement was installed over the older one, which has raised the courtyard level to the same level as the building's historic plinth. Due to an ownership dispute, the building appears to have been abandoned even though regular ritual activity in the tantric shrine upstairs continues.According to Devraj Shakya, the donor for the new building was Kula Narasiṃha Śākya from Nakabahī. The Digichẽ was restored again some time around 1948 (Weiler2009, 252). The two-storey house is actually an Āgaṃchẽ of the Aśoka Stūpa North. One can find the esoteric deities Cakrasaṃvara and Vajravārāhī along with Bhairava, Vetāla and Kālī on the first floor, whilst the ground floor houses a stone statue of Chvāsakaminī. It is believed that Chvāsakaminī represents Hārītī on Svayambhū Hill. The dormer is decorated with the syllableseandvaṃas well as akūṭākṣaramantra related to Mahayana Buddhism (ha-kṣa-ma-la-va-ra-yaṃ).
description_ne: सन् १९३४ को भूकम्पमा परी पहिलाको एकतले भवन भत्किएपछि यो अहिलेको भवन बनाइएको भनिन्छ । देवराज शाक्यका अनुसार यो भवनका दाता नक बहीका कुलनरसिंह शाक्य हुन् । यो दिगिछें पछि सन् १९४८ मा फेरि पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो (Weiler2009, 252) । यो दुईतले भवन वास्तवमा अशोक स्तूप उत्तर (LAL1480) को आगमछें हो । भवनको पहिलो तलामा भैरव, वेताल र कालीको प्रतिमाका साथै चक्रसंवर र वज्रवाराहीका प्रतिमा राखिएका छन् । भुइँतलामा छ्वासकमिनीको प्रतिमा स्थापित छ । स्वयंभू डाँडाकी हारितीको प्रतिनिधित्व छ्वासकमिनीले गर्दछिन् भन्ने विश्वास गरिन्छ । दिगिछेंको छानामाथिको पुरमा कूटाक्षर मन्त्र "ह क्ष म ल व र यं" अनि त्यसको दायाँबायाँ "वं" र "ए" लेखिएको छ ।
